concerns.text: The plan substitutes the required open‑access telomere‑length and individual‑level lifespan dataset with a generic CSV (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/vhada/Roco-csvs/resolve/main/test.csv`). This CSV does not contain authentic telomere or lifespan measurements for wild birds, nor does it source ecological covariates from AnAge or BirdLife as mandated by Constitution Principle VI. Using a placeholder dataset violates the ‘right dataset’ requirement of the specification and renders the analysis unable to answer the core research question.
